edges.rationale: Symfony framework relies heavily on Doctrine ORM for data access.
Using Docker for containerization is common in Symfony backend development.
Kubernetes is increasingly used for deploying and managing Symfony applications.
Jenkins is frequently used to orchestrate CI/CD pipelines for Symfony projects.
AWS is a common hosting platform for Symfony applications.
Linux is the standard operating system for backend development.
Elastic Cloud monitoring tools are used to observe Symfony application performance.
New Relic monitoring is often integrated with Symfony applications.
Terraform is used to manage infrastructure related to Symfony applications.
PHP is the core language for Symfony backend development.
Agile methodologies are commonly used in development teams.
DevOps practices are essential for the development and deployment of Symfony applications.
